capabilities: Fetch transcripts from YouTube video URLs
Generate summaries of video content using OpenAI GPT models
Insert clickable timestamps that open the video at that point
View transcripts in the sidebar or create notes with transcript and summary
Configure timestamp interval, transcript language, and OpenAI model
disambiguation: Not just a summarizer; it also fetches and displays transcripts with interactive timestamps.
intentEvidence: heavily inspired by and builds upon the YTranscript plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull YouTube transcripts into notes or summarize long videos automatically.

relations.evidence: This plugin is heavily inspired by and builds upon the YTranscript plugin

summary: YouTube transcript fetcher that creates summaries of video content using OpenAI GPT models, with clickable timestamps.
